name: The Dyed Web of Silkstrand
description: Beneath the legitimate silk and dye trade of Silkstrand lies a network of information brokers, forgeries, and quiet assassinations. The Web knows every bridge and every bribe; their colors are coded threads worn in the cuffs of the city's elite. They do not kill openly—they stain reputations and dye the water with secrets.
leverage: Forgery of guild seals, blackmail through trade secrets, control over dock tariffs, and access to the Archivolt's back rooms.
debtTrigger: When Obligation fills, the Web demands a single high-value contract—a forgery, a theft of a rival's ledger, or a 'drowning' in one of the canals. You will not be permitted to refuse.
quirk: Each member wears a thread in their left cuff: red for lieutenants, black for killers, and a thread the color of rust for those who have witnessed a death they cannot speak of.
keyNPCs: ‘Master’ Valeria (the current guild-mistress, never wears gloves—her hands are stained an indelible violet)
‘The Weft’ (a child with no tongue who writes secrets in disappearing ink)
Borso the Dyer (a genial merchant with a reputation for impossible colors—and blackmail material on half the city)
hooks: A member has disappeared with a list of clients and a sample of a supposedly 'unforgeable' guild seal. The Web wants them back—dead or alive, but the seal must be recovered.
A rival from the Brass Coast is trying to break the Web's monopoly on crimson silk. They are rumored to have a treaty with the Tide Father.
A new color has appeared in the canals at dawn. It is the same hue as the eyes of a dead bridge-bailiff. The Web is terrified—and refuses to speak of it.
